name: greenhouse-mcp
description: MCP server for the Greenhouse recruiting platform API

scripts.package:mac-arm64: node build.mjs && npx @yao-pkg/pkg dist/greenhouse-mcp.cjs -t node20-macos-arm64 -o release/greenhouse-mcp-macos-arm64 --compress GZip && codesign --sign - --force release/greenhouse-mcp-macos-arm64
scripts.package:win: node build.mjs && npx @yao-pkg/pkg dist/greenhouse-mcp.cjs -t node20-win-x64 -o release/greenhouse-mcp-win-x64.exe --compress GZip
scripts.package:all: npm run package:mac-arm64 && npm run package:win
